selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (e.g., Nano 3rd vs 4th gen) and ensure the class label is accurate beyond just 'media player'.
To verify that the devices sit naturally on the fabric without floating or incorrect shadow grounding, and to check for warping in the rectangular bodies.
To ensure the click wheel rings are continuous, closed loops without breaks or fusion into the casing, which is a common AI failure point for circular interfaces.
To analyze the coherence of the UI elements on the screens and detect any subtle gibberish or structural inconsistencies in the displayed images.

focus_areas: Geometric integrity of the click wheel circles (perfect roundness vs. wobble)
Legibility and structure of screen content (UI elements vs. hallucinated blobs)
Edge sharpness between the metallic/plastic casing and the fabric background
Consistency of lighting reflections on the glossy screens
